facts.fact: Clara 醒来看到的蓝眼睛男人不是昨晚门口那人——1901 版 Ben 是青年，门口男人是中年版。
facts.anchor: The man—who is not the guy I saw outside my apartment last night—holds out a hand toward me

facts.fact: 男人衣着是 1900 年前后样式：双排扣马甲、高硬领、old-fashioned tie（Clara 认出是 cravat）。
facts.anchor: His clothes are weird—a double-breasted vest, a white shirt with a high, stiff collar, and a wide … scarf? No, it’s an old-fashioned tie

facts.fact: Ben 自报家门：这里是 Ben Mitchell，且他们已不在 Clara 的 condo。
facts.anchor: I’m Ben Mitchell, and we’re not in your condo.

facts.fact: Ben 交代真相：Clara 和他一样从镜子掉进过去，现在是 1901 年，重复触发动作就能回 2024。
facts.anchor: You fell through the mirror into the past, the same way I did. It’s 1901

facts.fact: Ben 已被困许久（两年）；他自嘲租约大概早已到期。
facts.anchor: I guess my lease was probably up a long time ago. I’ve been missing for a while.

facts.fact: 房间是 The Villa 1901 原貌，与 Aunt Vi 装修前的 condo 镜像对称。
facts.anchor: This room looks like the condo did when Aunt Vi lived there before the remodel, only everything’s on the opposite side as mine.

facts.fact: Ben 一年半前才把镜子拿回手里，之后几乎每天尝试回家。
facts.anchor: At least every day, and almost constantly when I got the mirror back into my possession a year and a half ago.

facts.fact: Ben 写过镀金时代女装的硕士论文，并靠对历史事件的预知炒股发财。
facts.anchor: I wrote my master’s thesis on how Gilded Age fashions represented the physical and emotional restrictions of women of the time

facts.fact: Mr. Allen 金眼睛、英国口音登场，Clara 对他有种安放不了的熟悉感和记忆碎片。
facts.anchor: His voice, familiar in a way I can’t place, threatens another fog of memory to overtake me.

facts.fact: 章末 Rebecca Halloway 主动拉近关系，Clara 开始接受「这可能是真的」。
facts.anchor: Please, call me Rebecca. You’re wearing my evening dress, dear. I have a feeling we’re going to be good friends.
